0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Something goes bump in Greatest Endsvale, and it has Mopingway concerned.

48.original: Oh dear... Oh my, oh dear, this is terrible!

49.original: Thank goodness you're here! There's a strange sound coming from the waterway. I think there might be something wrong with the water regulation system.

50.original: What if the water starts to flow backwards? Or worse! Everything must be inspected from top to bottom, but time is of the essence, and I can't possibly hope to do it all on my own... Not as quickly as I'd like, at any rate. Please say you will help.

51.original: Oh, thank goodness. Look for the water towers to the north and you'll find the regulators.

52.original: If you can take care of that, I will see to the rest. We can reconvene here when you've finished.

53.original: Inspect the water towers to the north and I will see to the rest.

60.original: You hear nothing out of the ordinary.

61.original: You hear an odd bubbling murmur. This machine seems to be malfunctioning.

62.original: How did everything look on your side?

63.original: A murmur by the northeast regulator? Hmmm... I think I know what the problem is.

64.original: We released fish into the river so that our guests could go fishing, but they're likely attracted to the heat of the regulators.

65.original: Not to worry! This is but one little bump on the road to building a fantastic recreational facility, and thanks to you, the path forward can be made smoother.

66.original: When our work is finished, I hope you'll visit again and make the most of what we have to offer.
